metadata.title: Pork and Bitter Gourd | Naga recipe
metadata.description:
Hey guys, this is another amazing pork combination with a match made in heaven. Pork with Bitter gourds or Bitter melons, and bamboo shoots. What an amazing combination of ingredients. This lovely dish is easy to make and tasted awesome. 

Ingredients 

Pork -  500 gms
Bitter Gourd - 150-200 gms
Dry Red Chilies - 15-20 Nos
Bamboo shoot water/Fermented Bamboo shoot - 3 tablespoon/1 tablespoon
Tomatoes (If you dont have fermented bamboo shoot) - 3 large nos
Sichuan Pepper - 1 tablespoon
Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoon
Salt as required

Lets Connect!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/EatYourKappa/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/eatyourkappa/
email: eatyourkappa@gmail.com
https://twitter.com/eat_your_kappa
